verses.en: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.pt: E tu levanta uma lamentação sobre os príncipes de Israel,
verses.en_web: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.en_bbe: Take up now a song of grief for the ruler of Israel, and say,

verses.en: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
verses.pt: e dize: Que de leoa foi tua mãe entre os leões! Deitou-se no meio dos leõezinhos, criou os seus cachorros.
verses.en_web: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.
verses.en_bbe: What was your mother? Like a she-lion among lions, stretched out among the young lions she gave food to her little ones.

verses.en: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
verses.pt: Assim criou um dos seus cachorrinhos, o qual, fazendo-se leão novo, aprendeu a apanhar a presa; e devorou homens.
verses.en_web: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
verses.en_bbe: And one of her little ones came to growth under her care, and became a young lion, learning to go after beasts for his food; and he took men for his meat.

verses.en: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Ora as nações ouviram falar dele; foi apanhado na cova delas; e o trouxeram com ganchos à terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And the nations had news of him; he was taken in the hole they had made: and, pulling him with hooks, they took him into the land of Egypt.

verses.en: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
verses.pt: Vendo, pois, ela que havia esperado, e que a sua esperança era perdida, tomou outro dos seus cachorros, e fê-lo leão novo.
verses.en_web: “‘Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her cubs, and made him a young lion.
verses.en_bbe: Now when she saw that her hope was made foolish and gone, she took another of her little ones and made him into a young lion.

verses.en: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.
verses.pt: E este, rondando no meio dos leões, veio a ser leão novo, e aprendeu a apanhar a presa; e devorou homens.
verses.en_web: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
verses.en_bbe: And he went up and down among the lions and became a young lion, learning to go after beasts for his food; and he took men for his meat.

verses.en: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
verses.pt: E devastou os seus palácios, e destruiu as suas cidades; e assolou-se a terra, e a sua plenitude, por causa do som do seu rugido.
verses.en_web: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate, with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.
verses.en_bbe: And he sent destruction on their widows and made waste their towns; and the land and everything in it became waste because of the loud sound of his voice.

verses.en: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
verses.pt: Então se ajuntaram contra ele as gentes das províncias ao redor; estenderam sobre ele a rede; e ele foi apanhado na cova delas.
verses.en_web: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.
verses.en_bbe: Then the nations came against him from the kingdoms round about: their net was stretched over him and he was taken in the hole they had made.

verses.en: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.pt: E com ganchos meteram-no numa jaula, e o levaram ao rei de Babilônia; fizeram-no entrar nos lugares fortes, para que se não ouvisse mais a sua voz sobre os montes de Israel.
verses.en_web: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: They made him a prisoner with hooks, and took him to the king of Babylon; they put him in the strong place so that his voice might be sounding no longer on the mountains of Israel.

verses.en: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
verses.pt: Tua mãe era como uma videira plantada junto às águas; ela frutificou, e encheu-se de ramos, por causa das muitas aguas.
verses.en_web: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
verses.en_bbe: Your mother was in comparison like a vine, planted by the waters: she was fertile and full of branches because of the great waters.

verses.en: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
verses.pt: E tinha uma vara forte para cetro de governador, e elevou-se a sua estatura entre os espessos ramos, e foi vista na sua altura com a multidão dos seus ramos.
verses.en_web: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled. Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs. They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.
verses.en_bbe: And she had a strong rod for a rod of authority for the rulers, and it became tall among the clouds and it was seen lifted up among the number of its branches.

verses.en: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
verses.pt: Mas foi arrancada com furor, e lançada por terra; o vento oriental secou o seu fruto; quebrou-se e secou-se a sua forte vara; o fogo a consumiu.
verses.en_web: But it was plucked up in fury. It was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were broken off and withered. The fire consumed them.
verses.en_bbe: But she was uprooted in burning wrath, and made low on the earth; the east wind came, drying her up, and her branches were broken off; her strong rod became dry, the fire made a meal of it.

verses.en: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.
verses.pt: E agora está plantada no deserto, numa terra seca e sedenta.
verses.en_web: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
verses.en_bbe: And now she is planted in the waste land, in a dry and unwatered country.

verses.en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
verses.pt: E duma vara dos seus ramos saiu fogo que consumiu o seu fruto, de maneira que não há mais nela nenhuma vara forte para servir de cetro para governar. Essa é a lamentação, e servirá de lamentação.
verses.en_web: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.”
verses.en_bbe: And fire has gone out from her rod, causing the destruction of her branches, so that there is no strong rod in her to be the ruler's rod of authority. This is a song of grief, and it was for a song of grief.
